articles.title: In Chile, even beloved hot dogs feel the economic squeeze
articles.summary: SANTIAGO, Chile (AP) — It is lunchtime in downtown Santiago, and dozens of businesses around the Plaza de Armas are serving up one of Chile’s most democratic specialties: the “completo.”

articles.title: This Toronto director turned his hometown into a film. Now, it’s premiering at TIFF
articles.summary: What happens when a filmmaker makes a movie about the neighbourhood where he grew up? Sunburn, set on one of the hottest days of the year in Toronto's St. James Town, makes its world premiere tonight at TIFF. CBC's Haydn Watters travelled to Bleecker Street to chat with the director and cast.

articles.title: 5-vehicle collision leads to major delays on DVP, Gardiner Expressway
articles.summary: A five-vehicle collision led to major traffic delays on the Don Valley Parkway (DVP) leading into the Gardiner Expressway on Saturday night. Emergency crews were called to the DVP, near Gerrard Street East, just before 7 p.m. At least two people were transported to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. articles.title: Toronto peace groups host downtown march against gun violence
articles.summary: Two Toronto peace organizations held a community march against gun violence in the city’s downtown core Saturday, following the fatal shooting of a 17-year-old earlier this week.

articles.title: Former Toronto Raptor Kyle Lowry awarded key to city, statue at Jurassic Park
articles.summary: Former Toronto Raptor Kyle Lowry was awarded a key to the city at a block party downtown Saturday, recognizing his contributions to the community on and off the court.

articles.title: Candidates in Toronto's east end are arguing over a Gardiner ramp that doesn't exist anymore
articles.summary: A years-gone ramp on the Gardiner Expressway is haunting the race for city councillor in Toronto’s east end, with some candidates saying another’s promise to resurrect it is just smoke and mirrors.

articles.title: Artists in Durham Region gear up for annual free festival featuring 'symphony' of arts
articles.summary: Artists across Durham Region are preparing for a free festival next month that’s in its 45th year of showcasing local talent.

articles.title: Motorcyclist, 74, dies after single-vehicle crash in Vaughan
articles.summary: A motorcyclist has died after a single-vehicle crash in Vaughan on Friday evening, Ontario provincial police say.

articles.title: Man, 61, dead after car and dump truck collide in Caledon, police say
articles.summary: A 61-year-old man is dead after a car and dump truck collided in Caledon early Friday, police say.
